reviews.x: This brush is huge. Way bigger than a standard sized brush. The bristles are exactly what I wanted, but the brush itself is way, way too big overall for my head/hair type. I should have reviewed the product dimensions more thoroughly.  If you have a lot of thick hair this might work, but I can't use it.

It's works amazing, and I love it. It's more comfortable to use, and snags my hair less, than every plastic/nylon brush I've ever used. The handle is comfortable, and the whole thing is really well made. I expect it to last for years.  The only reason it doesn't get 5 stars, is because it does nothing to kill static. My hair gets REALLY staticy during the winter, and it still sparks and frizzes when I brush it. Honestly,

I love this brush! I was looking for one with wooden bristles after my hair dresser told me that wooden bristle brushes are good for your hair. I haven't had it long enough to know if it actually absorbs and redistributes the oils in my hair, but it is a sturdy, nicely-designed brush. I am very satisfied with this purchase.

I ordered this brush mainly for the anti-static claim which really doesn't work,  there is no difference on my hair static, and the bristles fall off so easy, my hair is only above my shoulders I can just imagine how it would be if I had long hair!
So I purchased this and received it in the bag but it is missing a bristle already! Never been used and already faulty. It is a great brush otherwise!
I go through these like crazy with my thick hair, but nothing beats a wooden, pin brush!
too big ! always knock my head when i use it with left hand !

My eldest daughter has hair down past her bum. It’s thin but plentiful hair that tangled easily. This style of brush is the only one she’ll use. For the price, this is the best one I’ve found. I do give it a mid-ranged 3-stars on sturdiness because I have to replace it every 6 months or so. Some of the bristles aren’t always in as well as others. This causes them to detach and over a few months it’s down to half. I give it 5 stars overall because getting a 17 year old girl to brush nearly 4 feet

reviews.t: Good product at a great price but it doesn't hold up well over time
reviews.x: I'm very satisfied.  I'm a guy with long hair and I love the natural wood look, the large handle  fits well in my hand and it has a round hole which I use to hang it up.  I pulled one of the bristles out and broke it in half and confirmed they are real (albeit coated) wood.  It's also comfortable to use on my scalp and easy to clean the hair out of.  UPDATE after a year of use.  Many bristles have come out as the rubber base has degraded and become stained and discolored. I would not order this

I have been looking for this brush everywhere in the American market I had one from different country. My daughter hair is curly and her scalp is so sensitive and all brushes hurt her so much, especially the ones that have pointy ends as the curls tangle around them. But this design is the only one that flows smoothly with least pain. Excellent product and good price. The rest r selling the same or sth similar for higher price

reviews.t: I wanted the feel of the bristles against my head
reviews.x: I was not looking for a soft, gentle brush for my hair.  I wanted to feel it on my scalp.  For some people this might feel too strong against the scalp, but that is what I wanted.  I tried a couple of other "rougher" brushes available here.  It was not the sharpest one that I have ever felt, but of the ones I could purchase on Amazon, it was.

I have very fine hair. Brushes with knobs on the ends of the bristles catch in it and break it. Brushes with thin bristles tend to knot the hair. The rubber holding the bristles is soft enough that hey tend to bend, rather than break my hair.  Easy on y scalp and very comfortable to use.

This brush lasted just under a year and a half before the bristle pad fell off of the handle. It could probably be hot glued back together. Prior to that, it worked fine. Seemed sturdy enough to tackle my thick hair and painlessly detangled my hair without adding any static.

I have thick and curly hair and this brush lasted a substantially longer time than most other wet brushes I've purchased. The backing popped off one time after a few months of use, but it pops right back in and it doesn't affect use much. Would buy again for the price!

I bought this because my older wooden hairbrush was getting some buildup on the bristles (I’m sure I could have cleaned it but I wanted an excuse to buy a fresh one). The paddle is very large and the bristles are very soft. I highly recommend

reviews.t: Wood brushes are better for everyone’s hair
reviews.x: I use it everyday and I like it so far, it’s replaced all my other brushes, plus I heard it distributes oil from scalp to ends of hair when using wood. So I’m all about health for hair. Thank you for fast delivery and nice packaging

reviews.t: Might hurt for sensitive skin people
reviews.x: (The brush on the left is the new, the right one is old) Got the brush early, it feels nice but can be alittle "sharp" you can see at the end of the right one it has rounded tip, so this might not be for those who are sensitive.

Love the brush, the wood design is beautiful and the bristles are very unique. This brush doesn’t eliminate static, which I didn’t think it would, but it does brush through very nice. Will be buying again for my daughters.

This is my second purchase of a wooden brush.  I got this one for a friend who loved my brush.  It’s made well and the wooden bristles are securely attached.  I wouldn’t use any other brush on my hair.
My hair is about mid-back length and I am trying to grow it longer, so I did some research and found these are better for your hair and distribute oils well. So far I really like this brush.

reviews.t: No more static when I brush my hair
reviews.x: I have thin fine hair so especially during the winter I have alot of static in my hair and makes it hard to style.  This brush is amazing and I love it no more static......
My husband has long hair and loves wooden bristles with out the bumps on the tips. This brush looks to be stronger than others he used. Great size and value fir the money!
I like the brush size and feel, but it definitely hasn't been controlling my static, like it claimed to. It has been working the same as any plastic brush.
Like a lot! Just arrived missing a couple bristle heads... Didn’t appear to have fallen out en route—just missing w holes in the brush; otherwise great!
Perfect for me. I have thin hair that usually brushes easily despite it constantly getting tangled. This brush feels sturdy and is a great purchase!

claims.text: Many reviewers love the brush and find it comfortable, well-made, and good value for the price.
Several reviewers find the brush too large, especially for smaller heads or certain hair types.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including bristles falling out or the bristle pad/backing detaching over time.
Reviewers with thick, curly, or long hair say it detangles well and is gentle on sensitive scalps.
A few reviewers say the anti-static claim does not work for them.
